reaper.name: Headsman's Axe
reaper.desc: A slow, crushing greataxe swing at enemies in front of you. Anything left under 22% health is Executed. Every hit builds Rage.
reaper.up3: Every third swing goes all the way around you.
reaper.evoD: Swings 25% faster and Executes anything under 35% health.

cleave.name: Fury Strikes
cleave.desc: A fast 3-hit axe combo; the third hit heals you. Enemies under 25% health are Executed for triple damage. Every hit builds Rage.
cleave.up3: The finisher hits all the way around you.
cleave.evoD: Every finisher unleashes 4 extra lightning-fast strikes.

whirl.name: Whirlwind
whirl.desc: Spends Rage to spin through everything around you, then you become Enraged: attacks 30% faster for 4 seconds.
whirl.evoD: Spins longer and drags enemies into the blades.

slam.name: Thunder Clap
slam.desc: A shockwave that launches crowds of enemies around you.
slam.evoD: Leaves a burning crack that keeps hurting.

shield.name: Hurled Axe
shield.desc: Hurls a spare axe that bounces between enemies.

riposte.name: Iron Skin
riposte.desc: Every few seconds a shield forms that blocks one hit, then strikes back all around you.
riposte.up3: Holds two shields and recharges faster.
riposte.evoD: Breaking a shield stuns nearby enemies and heals you.

ravager.name: Ravager
ravager.desc: A ghostly axe circles you and cuts everything it touches.
ravager.up3: A second axe joins the orbit.
ravager.evoD: A third axe; they spin faster and hit harder.

blood.name: Bloodthirst
blood.desc: Every 12 kills you hurl a blood axe that bounces between enemies and heals you on every hit.
blood.up3: Every 10 kills, and the axe bounces once more.
blood.evoD: Every 8 kills, and it heals more.

charge.name: Phantom Charge
charge.desc: A ghost of you charges the toughest enemy nearby, trampling everything in its path.
charge.evoD: Two phantoms charge side by side.

earth.name: Earthsplitter
earth.desc: Splits the ground toward the nearest enemy; it erupts a moment later and launches them.

hook.name: Chain Hook
hook.desc: Hooks the farthest enemy (gunmen first) and yanks it to your axes.
hook.evoD: Drags in everything along the chain.

banner.name: War Banner
banner.desc: Plants a banner that hurts enemies around it. Standing near it makes both of you attack 25% faster.
banner.up3: Bigger, lasts longer and slows enemies.
banner.evoD: The banner also heals you both.

shout.name: Battle Shout
shout.desc: When surrounded, a roar blasts enemies away and makes them flee in fear.
shout.up3: Also gives you both +20% damage for 4 seconds.
shout.evoD: Each roar grants 30 Rage and heals you both.

cinder.name: Cinders
cinder.desc: Lobs burning cinders that splash and set enemies on fire.
cinder.evoD: Cinders leave pools of fire where they land.

beam.name: Light Bolts
beam.desc: Fires bolts of lantern light at the nearest enemy, faster the longer you keep shooting. Bolts that fly through your partner heal them.
beam.evoD: Bolts fire faster and pierce through 3 enemies.

prism.name: Prism
prism.desc: Each bolt that hits splits into a smaller bolt toward another enemy.

lighthouse.name: Lighthouse
lighthouse.desc: A beam slowly sweeps around you like a lighthouse.

flies.name: Fireflies
flies.desc: Fireflies orbit you and burn what they touch.
flies.up3: More fireflies in a wider ring.

moths.name: Ember Moths
moths.desc: Releases moths of living flame that home in on enemies farther away and set them alight.
moths.evoD: Six moths, and each hit spawns another.

starfall.name: Star Fall
starfall.desc: Stars rain down on enemies around you.
starfall.evoD: Bigger stars that set enemies on fire.

lanterns.name: Paper Lanterns
lanterns.desc: Paper lanterns float up, drift over the enemies, then drop and burst.
lanterns.evoD: Each burst leaves a pool of fire.

garden.name: Glow Garden
garden.desc: Glowing flowers bloom where you walk. They heal you both and slow and hurt enemies.
garden.up3: Flowers bloom faster and last longer.
garden.evoD: Fading flowers burst into cutting petals.

halo.name: Halo Pulse
halo.desc: A ring of light expands from you and knocks enemies back.
halo.up3: Two rings, one after the other.
halo.evoD: Rings stun enemies and heal your partner.

candle.name: Candle Wards
candle.desc: Drops candles at your feet that explode when enemies come close.
candle.up3: Drops two candles at a time.
candle.evoD: Blasts pull enemies in and set off nearby candles.

rites.name: Last Rites
rites.desc: On your beat, every wounded enemy close to you under 20% health is Executed at once, and each one heals you a little.
rites.evoD: Executes anything nearby under 30% health and ignites a crimson shockwave.

knell.name: Death Knell
knell.desc: When a crowd closes in, a great bell tolls: every enemy on screen under 30% health dies, and the rest are stunned.
knell.evoD: Executes under 40% and the stun lasts twice as long.

guillotine.name: Guillotine
guillotine.desc: A giant ghostly axe appears over the thickest crowd, hangs for a heartbeat, then drops like a guillotine.
guillotine.up3: The impact sends out a second, wider shockwave.
guillotine.evoD: Three axes fall one after another in a line.

vortex.name: Blade Vortex
vortex.desc: Hurls a spinning tornado of axes that spirals outward, dragging enemies into the blades.
vortex.up3: A bigger tornado that lasts longer.
vortex.evoD: Two tornadoes spiral out at once.

grip.name: Titan's Grip
grip.desc: A giant ghostly fist bursts out of the ground, grabs a crowd, lifts it and smashes it down.
grip.up3: Grabs a wider area and stuns longer.
grip.evoD: The fist smashes them down three times.

carnage.name: Carnage
carnage.desc: Enemies you kill can burst into a ring of red-hot shrapnel, and shrapnel kills can burst again.
carnage.evoD: Bursts happen far more often and the shards cut through everything.

constellation.name: Constellation
constellation.desc: Marks enemies with stars, draws a constellation between them, then the whole shape explodes.
constellation.up3: Two more stars in every constellation.
constellation.evoD: Bigger constellations that stun everything they touch.

aurora.name: Aurora
aurora.desc: A shimmering curtain of northern lights sweeps across the field, burning and slowing everything it passes.
aurora.up3: The curtain sweeps back a second time.
aurora.evoD: A wider curtain that heals the Warden as it passes over him.

rose.name: Rose Window
rose.desc: A stained-glass rose window forms above you, spins, then shatters into a storm of rainbow glass.
rose.evoD: The window rebuilds and shatters a second time.

wisp.name: Fire Fox
wisp.desc: A fox made of living flame darts from enemy to enemy, leaving a glowing trail behind it.
wisp.evoD: A nine-tailed fox that hops further and leaves foxfire where it lands.

hellchain.name: Hellchains
hellchain.desc: Burning chains burst out of the ground, hook a group of enemies and yank them together into a fiery collision.
hellchain.evoD: The chains yank and explode a second time.

wyrm.name: Wyrm Breath
wyrm.desc: A spectral dragon rises behind you and breathes a cone of ghostfire at the crowd in front of you.
wyrm.evoD: The breath lasts longer and leaves the ground burning.

obelisk.name: Deco Spires
obelisk.desc: A ring of gilded obelisks erupts out of the roof around you, launching everything they hit.
obelisk.evoD: Three rings of spires, each taller than the last.

thunder.name: Thunderlord
thunder.desc: Violet lightning crashes down from the sky onto enemies around you, one strike after another.
thunder.evoD: Every strike forks into nearby enemies.

bloodmoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodmoon.desc: When you are swarmed, a red moon rises: every enemy near you bleeds, and every kill heals you.
bloodmoon.evoD: Enemies under the moon are also slowed.

legion.name: Ghost Legion
legion.desc: Three spectral copies of you charge forward in formation, cutting through everything in their path.
legion.up3: Five ghosts charge instead of three.
legion.evoD: The legion charges twice, out and back.

firewall.name: Firewall
firewall.desc: Raises a wall of fire across the path of the nearest enemies. Everything that walks through it burns.
firewall.evoD: The wall closes into a full ring around the crowd.

pyre.name: Pyre
pyre.desc: On your beat, every burning enemy near you erupts, hurting and igniting everything around it.
pyre.evoD: Eruptions leave pools of fire behind.

phoenix.name: Phoenix
phoenix.desc: A phoenix of light circles you in a figure of eight, burning everything it flies through.
phoenix.up3: A bigger phoenix that flies longer.
phoenix.evoD: Its feathers leave burning trails, and it heals the Warden when it passes him.

heaven.name: Heaven's Pillars
heaven.desc: Columns of holy light slam down from the sky onto enemies, burning and slowing them.
heaven.evoD: The pillars linger and heal anyone standing in them.

cranes.name: Paper Cranes
cranes.desc: A flock of origami cranes takes off, circles up, then dives onto enemies and bursts into confetti.
cranes.evoD: Every crane splits into two on impact.

starwell.name: Starwell
starwell.desc: Opens a swirling galaxy in the middle of a crowd that drags enemies in, then collapses in a burst of stars.
starwell.evoD: The collapse hits much harder and stuns survivors.

clock.name: Clockwork Halt
clock.desc: A giant deco clock appears over a crowd and freezes time inside it. When it strikes twelve, the frozen enemies shatter.
clock.evoD: The shatter hits much harder and leaves enemies slowed.

fireworks.name: Grand Finale
fireworks.desc: Launches fireworks that streak into the sky and burst into showers of colour over enemies.
fireworks.evoD: Every burst sets off a crackling second explosion.

kite.name: Sun Kite
kite.desc: A kite of light floats above your partner and shoots at enemies near them.
kite.evoD: Every few seconds the kite fires a piercing ray.
